plot_spine.summary: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her mother's bridal gown, only to be abandoned at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa with her family's blessing.
Publicly cast aside, Juliana stands tall and turns her humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
Banished from the chapel and seized by guards, Juliana is rescued by an imposing scarred stranger who proposes to her.
Defying Gerald and Clarissa, Juliana accepts the mysterious warrior's proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity.
Formally disowned and stripped of her inheritance, Juliana is humiliated when her ledger is thrown in the mud, but her husband defends her.
Seeking shelter from the rain, Juliana arrives at her husband's modest woodland cottage and finds peace.
When Gerald and his companion arrive to mock Juliana, her stoic husband returns from the forest to send them fleeing.
Juliana inspects her mother's herbal grimoire while Alexander bonds with her over rustic medicinal knowledge and war memories.
When a frantic mother brings her ill child to the cottage, Juliana cures him with herbal remedies, sparking dangerous rumors.
Alexander returns gravely wounded, leading to an intimate confrontation where their pasts collide.
Gerald and Clarissa arrive with a constable accusing Alexander of theft, threatening to tear the newlyweds apart.
Clarissa offers Juliana a sadistic ultimatum: retrieve a signet ring from blackthorn briars with bare hands or watch her husband hang.
Juliana crawls barehanded into the blackthorn garden, enduring brutal lacerations to unearth the emerald signet ring.
After securing Alexander's freedom, he carries her home to bandage her torn hands and vows protection.
When thugs desecrate Juliana's medicinal garden, a protective Alexander charges into the night to defend her.
Alexander overpowers the thugs and extracts a confession unmasking Gerald Harrington as the mastermind.
Alexander repairs the garden and swears to protect Juliana, drawing them into a tender embrace by the hearth.
When their cottage is set ablaze, Alexander rescues Juliana and her mother's ledger from the inferno, vowing vengeance.
Receiving shelter from villagers, Alexander learns from a loyal spy that his enemies have imprisoned his mother and claimed his ducal seat.
Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess withers, while Juliana prepares remedies in a barn.
After curing a village boy, Juliana learns the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
Disguised as a scullery maid, Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor and discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from poison.
Juliana discovers the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic, just as someone arrives at the bedroom door.
An arrogant noblewoman catches Juliana in the chambers, strikes her with a riding crop, and orders her to scrub the hearth.
In the forest, Alexander confronts an injured Juliana and reacts with fury upon learning of the arsenic poisoning.
While administering an antidote at night, Juliana is stunned when the Duchess recognizes her family ring and demands the truth.
Before Juliana can reveal Alexander's name, Rupert and Catherine storm the bedchamber and frame her for poisoning.
Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana, uncover her noble identity and herbarium, and order her to the dungeons.
Thrown into subterranean cells as Catherine threatens to burn her mother's herbarium, Juliana swears they will never take Alexander.
Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana.
Catherine subjects the chained heiress to ruthless psychological torment with a red-hot iron.
Chained in the dungeon, Juliana shatters Catherine's cruelty with unshakeable dignity, driving Catherine into a murderous fury.
A young maid is manipulated through coercion and threats to give false testimony framing Juliana for witchcraft.
Put on trial for witchcraft, Lady Juliana stands proud and defiant in the prisoner's dock.
Alexander's elderly mother escapes through a blizzard to a cabin, reuniting with her presumed-dead son.
Learning of Juliana's imprisonment and execution, Alexander vows to return from the dead and reclaim everything.
As Rupert and Catherine issue wedding invitations paired with Juliana's execution decree, Juliana endures starvation.
A compassionate guard secretly feeds Juliana bread as distant wedding bells signal the start of Rupert's nuptials.
Alexander's men neutralize guards while Alexander dons his ducal regalia to march forth and rescue Juliana.
High society gathers for Rupert and Catherine's wedding, unaware Alexander's retribution is at their gates.
Juliana is paraded in chains before high society until an explosion shatters the cathedral entrance, heralding Alexander.
Emerging from smoke in full ducal regalia, Alexander confronts Rupert and is proclaimed rightful Duke by his mother.
Royal guards refuse Rupert's arrest orders and salute the true Duke as Crown intelligence documents expose treason.
Lord Sterling and Rupert are apprehended by the Crown while Catherine's pleas are coldly rejected by Alexander.
Alexander frees Juliana and proclaims her Duchess before an ecclesiastical authority bursts in to invalidate their marriage.
The High Priest invalidates the wedding for lack of a royal license, prompting Alexander to demand a ten-day trial.
A destitute Catherine begs for sanctuary at Ashbourne, and Juliana offers her survival under the humiliation of a scullery maid.
Feigning submission, Catherine schemes in secret to use the ten-day reprieve to strike back with Father Thomas.
Meeting Father Thomas at dawn, Catherine orchestrates a conspiracy to stall the council hearing and extract intelligence.
Catherine negotiates Father Thomas's silence with territorial control, unaware Agnes has witnessed their scandalous intimacy.
